title: WibeZz delivered a hard-hitting cut titled "Cold," with $wanky.
htmlContent:
Germany-based artist WibeZz shares a new single, "Cold," a track showcasing his unique music style. His lyrical performance underlines his sharp lyricism and storytelling.

WibeZz delivered a hard-hitting cut titled "Cold," which comes through with a unique lyrical style from $wanky. "Cold" is pure bravado, as WibeZz uses smooth groove elements with bravado lyrics.

Stream WibeZz's "Cold" on Spotify.

Connect with WibeZz on Instagram.
